a: A shadow-DOM node in an a11y finding can never be highlighted: its selector chain is joined into one descendant selector
An index page's frame ignores `a11y.highlight`, so the A11y panel can't outline anything on an index page
An index page's frame never reports or applies its document scroll, so loupe copies and captures of a scrolled index page show its top
Overriding a token reports a stale value for every token defined through it
On a frame with an iframe, a highlight box is placed in the wrong spot and doesn't follow the inner document's scroll
b: Shadow-DOM a11y findings can never be highlighted: `finding()` flattens the shadow path that `resolveTarget` needs split
An index page in a frame ignores `a11y.highlight`, `scroll` and `vars.set`, which a story frame handles
A throw from `applyGlobals` on an index page escapes the channel handler, and the trial never hears back
Overriding a CSS var leaves every var derived from it stale in the vars report
An index page's fault drops the stack that story faults carry
The a11y highlight box is misplaced for a target inside an iframe
